# Place all model weight files (.pt) in this folder.
#
# Expected files:
#   yolov8n.pt              — YOLO nano (used for ROI extraction)
#   yolov8x.pt              — YOLO extra-large (used for inference tracking)
#   standing_lying.pt       — Posture model (EfficientNetV2, 2 classes)
#   food_idle_behavior.pt   — Feeding model (EfficientNetV2, 2 classes)
#   all_5_classes.pt        — Full 5-class model (EfficientNetV2)
#
# Download YOLOv8 weights: https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics
# Trained cattle weights: generated by running src/training/train.py
